title: SM DC1C
text: 离散时间或连续时间同步电机 DC1C 励磁系统，包括自动电压调节器和励磁机，输入 9 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator output gain, K_A (pu)} 调节器增益、{Regulator time constant, T_A (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B (s)} 调节器滞后时间常数、{Regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C (s)} 调节器超前时间常数、{Rate feedback gain, K_F (pu)} 指定速率反馈增益、{Rate feedback time constant, T_F (s)} 指定速率反馈时间常数、{Maximum controller output, V_Rmax (pu)} 控制器输出上限、{Minimum controller output, V_Rmin (pu)} 控制器输出下限、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定过励限制器输入位置、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定欠励限制器输入位置、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定定子电流限制器输入位置、{Exciter field proportional constant, K_E (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场增益、{Exciter field time constant, T_E (s)} 指定励磁机磁场时间常数、{Lower limit, E_FDmin (pu)} 指定励磁电压下限、{Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_1), E_1 (pu)} 指定第一饱和输出电压、{Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_1, S_E(E_1) (1)} 指定第一饱和查表电压、{Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_2), E_2 (pu)} 指定第二饱和输出电压、{Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_2, S_E(E_2) (1)} 指定第二饱和查表电压，按实例取值。
